# Parameter read-back probes (SITL only; generated by `scripts/ardupilot/ap_param_probe.py`)

Environment `SITL` (ArduCopter 4.7.1). These read parameters from the *simulator* over SERIAL0 (PARAM_REQUEST_READ) while a
strictly receive-only monitor sat on SERIAL1 of the passive-monitor harness (`ap_netns_run_passive.sh`). Not a physical controller.

| dir | what it shows |
|---|---|
| `diag_params_064223` | `SR0_*`/`SR1_*`/`SR2_*` do **not exist** in 4.7.1 (every read returned nothing); the simulator answered the unknown names with 7 `PARAM_ERROR` messages seen by the monitor. `SERIAL1_PROTOCOL=2` was applied. So the first `sitl_defaults_monitor_port.parm` (written with `SR1_*` names) was a **no-op**: runs `ap_passive_monitor_001` and `ap_passive_monitor_hb_001` used it and therefore show only "default parameters, no streams", not a test of persistent stream configuration. |
| `diag_params_064406` | `MAV1_*` and `MAV2_*` stream-rate parameters **exist** and default to 0 in this build. |
| `diag_params_064455` | after correcting the defaults file to `MAV2_EXT_STAT=2, MAV2_POSITION=5, MAV2_EXTRA1=10, MAV2_EXTRA2=5`, the read-back returns exactly those values, and the strictly receive-only monitor on SERIAL1 (`tx_frames 0`) received all six pipeline messages (`monitor_events.jsonl`). |

Source confirmation (read-only): `ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp:389` says `// SR0 through SR6 was here` and `:590` mounts the GCS group as `MAV`.
